title: Covering design C(18,9,5,6)
statement: Find 9-subsets (blocks) of {1, ..., 18} such that every 6-subset meets some block in at least 5 points, with as few blocks as possible. The best known size in the Covering Repository is 34 blocks (ours); a design with fewer blocks improves it.
submission: Text file: one block per line, 9 distinct points from 1..18 separated by spaces.

best_known.source: Covering Repository (coveringrepository.com), C(18,9,5,6) = 34 blocks: ours, listed since 2026-10-26 (before it 35); read 6 Nov 2026

provenance.revision: repository read on the date given

score: the number of blocks (smaller is better)
quantavane_note: our object is the best known entry of the source table
